extension.news: Version 0.1.0 Initial skeleton. Provisioning features not yet implemented.
extension.description: Build Manager provisions Kodi devices to a declared desired state. Define what each device should have installed and configured; Build Manager applies the specification. Supports tvOS, Android, Fire TV, and macOS.
